text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome. The combination of maternal non-immunity to rubella, prematurity, respiratory support history, and current symptoms of apnea and anemia (likely due to cardiac or pulmonary pathology) is highly suggestive of this diagnosis.
